title: Gan Ning Raids a Camp with a Hundred Riders; Zuo Ci Torments Cao Cao
summary: Gan Ning takes a hundred men with white goose feathers in their helmets straight through Cao Cao's camp at midnight and comes back without losing one. Sun Quan: 'Cao Cao has his Zhang Liao. I have my Gan Xingba.'
At Xuchang the Daoist Zuo Ci makes a fool of Cao Cao at a banquet — producing perch out of an empty basin, oranges that are hollow, and finally himself, in every direction at once.
history: The hundred riders are historical. Zuo Ci is folklore, imported to show Cao Cao, at the height of his power, unable to catch one old man.

pins.note: A hundred riders, white feathers, and no losses.
'Cao Cao has his Zhang Liao. I have my Gan Xingba.'
Cannot be caught, executed, or got rid of.
